subheading: Turn a single image into a textured 3D model, then refine its topology and UVs, with the Hunyuan 3D workflow cluster in ComfyUI.
extendedDescription:
Going from image to 3d used to mean hours of manual modeling from reference. The workflows on this page generate a 3D model directly from a single picture: upload an image of a character, prop, or product, and get a textured mesh you can orbit, export, and drop into a 3D pipeline. The featured Image to 3D workflow handles the common case end to end.

What makes this page more than a demo is the cluster around it. The Hunyuan 3D workflows cover the production steps that usually happen after generation: parts decomposition splits a model into separate components, smart topology rebuilds the mesh with cleaner geometry, and UV unwrapping prepares it for texturing in a standard DCC tool. Together they take a generated mesh meaningfully closer to something you can actually use in a game engine or renderer.

Every step is an editable ComfyUI graph. Run the whole chain on Comfy Cloud in the browser with no install, or locally in ComfyUI, and export standard mesh formats. Because generation is cheap to re-run, you can iterate on the source image, camera angle, or prompt until the silhouette is right before spending any time on cleanup.

howToUse: Open the Image to 3D workflow on Comfy Cloud with the Try button, or load it in your local ComfyUI.
Upload a clear image of the object or character, ideally with the full silhouette visible.
Run the workflow and inspect the generated mesh and texture in the preview.
Re-run with a better angle or cleaner source image if the shape needs work.
Pass the result through the topology and UV workflows when you need production-ready geometry.
Export the mesh in a standard format for your engine or 3D tool.

faqItems.question: What do I get out of an image to 3D workflow?
faqItems.answer: A textured 3D mesh generated from your image, exportable in standard formats for game engines, renderers, and 3D tools.

faqItems.question: What kind of images work best?
faqItems.answer: Clear images with the full object visible and minimal occlusion. Character turnarounds and product shots on plain backgrounds convert most cleanly.

faqItems.question: Is the generated mesh ready for a game engine?
faqItems.answer: Generated meshes are dense. The smart topology and UV unwrapping workflows on this page rebuild the geometry and coordinates so the asset works in production pipelines.

faqItems.question: Which models power these workflows?
faqItems.answer: The cluster is built around the Hunyuan 3D family for generation, decomposition, retopology, and UV unwrapping, plus a general single-image-to-model workflow.

faqItems.question: Do I need to install anything?
faqItems.answer: No. Every workflow runs on Comfy Cloud in the browser via the Try buttons, and the same graphs run in a local ComfyUI if you prefer.
